summary: First-run e2e testing of Biz-transPay MVP. Backend: 33/33 pytest passed (1 Stripe test skipped due to invalid Stripe key). Frontend: landing/register/login/dashboard + all 8 dashboard subpages load successfully with data-testid coverage. Registration flow works: user created, welcome bonuses (25000 XOF + 15000 XAF) shown, KYC banner appears, dashboard redirect ok, success toast shown. Language toggle EN/FR functional on navbar. CRITICAL bug: Stripe deposit checkout endpoint fails with 'Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_emergent' because STRIPE_API_KEY env var is not configured in /app/backend/.env.

critical.issue: Stripe returns 500 'Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_emergent'. The backend/.env is missing STRIPE_API_KEY, so it falls back to literal 'sk_test_emergent' which Stripe rejects. Deposit flow is completely broken end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by backend Stripe key error - frontend cannot obtain a checkout_url. Not tested end-to-end.

issues: Partial i18n coverage: some strings remain in French even after switching to EN (e.g. dashboard 'Voir tout', support category options 'Général', FAQ questions). Low priority.

action_items: HIGH: Set a real Stripe test key in /app/backend/.env as STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_... (Emergent shared sandbox key). Current fallback value 'sk_test_emergent' is invalid per Stripe. After setting, restart backend and re-verify POST /api/deposits/checkout returns a checkout_url.
LOW: Complete i18n coverage for dashboard/support strings that remain in FR when EN is selected (Voir tout, Général, FAQ items).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 35: stripe.api_key falls back to literal string 'sk_test_emergent' which is not a valid Stripe key. Fail fast at startup with a clear error if STRIPE_API_KEY is missing, rather than surfacing the error only on first deposit attempt.

server.py transfer endpoint: allows sending funds to non-existent recipient in biz_to_biz mode (money is debited from sender but never credited anywhere, no error). Consider raising 404 if recipient username/email not found for biz_to_biz.
server.py is 537 lines - within limits, but consider splitting into routers (auth, wallet, transfers, deposits, links, kyc, api_keys, settings, support) for maintainability.
Deposit USD conversion uses hardcoded 600 XOF/USD; should be configurable or use exchange/rate helper for consistency.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all pages load; Stripe deposit not verifiable e2e)

test_credentials: Fresh users generated per test run via /register. Also used memory/test_credentials.md creds for a quick smoke check.
seed_data_creation: Test suite auto-creates TEST_-prefixed users, links, tickets per session. Not cleaned up (demo DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and runs cleanly against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Only Stripe checkout test is gated (auto-skips when key invalid). Once STRIPE_API_KEY is fixed, re-run pytest and manually verify POST /api/deposits/checkout + /api/payments/status/{session_id} flow. Frontend: all pages render, KYC auto-approve works, transfer/exchange/links/api-keys/settings/support all reachable. i18n has minor gaps.
rca of the issue: STRIPE INVALID API KEY: /app/backend/.env does not define STRIPE_API_KEY. In server.py line 35, `stripe.api_key = os.environ.get('STRIPE_API_KEY') or 'sk_test_emergent'` results in the literal fallback string being used, which is not a real Stripe secret key. Reproduction: `curl -X POST /api/deposits/checkout ...` returns `{"detail":"Stripe error: Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent"}`. Fix: Add STRIPE_API_KEY=<real Emergent shared sandbox sk_test_...> to /app/backend/.env and restart backend.
